lesson_fields.title: Density and Pressure
lesson_fields.summary: Density ρ = m/V (kg/m³). Pressure P = F/A (Pa). Applications: floating, hydraulic systems.
lesson_fields.summary_fr: Masse volumique ρ = m/V (kg/m³). Pression P = F/A (Pa). Applications : flottabilité, systèmes hydrauliques.
lesson_fields.content:
## Basics

Density ρ = mass / volume (kg/m³). Pressure P = force / area (N/m² = Pa).
lesson_fields.content_fr:
Bases

Masse volumique ρ = masse / volume (kg/m³). Pression P = force / surface (N/m² = Pa).

steps.title: Density

steps.title: Floating
steps.content: An object floats if its density < density of the fluid.
steps.content_fr: Un objet flotte si sa densité < densité du fluide.

steps.content: ρ = m/V. P = F/A. Smaller area, higher pressure.
